name: openhouse
description: Rent-to-own, on-chain — the protocol takes 0–5% (owner-set, zero allowed, capped in the contract) and 95–100% of every payment stays with the property as renter equity and owner income — with proof of rent paid, without the tenant: the bank runs a Cairo statement over the private payment, NEAR (WASM) and Ethereum verifiers check the fact, and the chain learns only that this home, this month, was paid

mcp.docs: Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP) tool server for LLM agents — POST /mcp on the API, 55 tools. Start: openhouse_examples / openhouse_run_example (testnet walkthroughs, each a transcript of real tool calls, run in a throwaway store). Reads: openhouse_terms, quote, models, status, property, rent_stats, rent_ledger, equity, shareholders, portfolio, dividends, civic, landscape, source, fx. Writes (testnet bookkeeping, no signed transactions): openhouse_pay_rent, purchase, set_terms, claim_owner, distribute, toggle_active, transfer_authority, civic_charter, civic_override, civic_resign. Banks (any bank): openhouse_bank_kinds, bank_status, bank_connect, bank_disconnect, bank_accounts, bank_transactions, bank_import, bank_receive, bank_reference, bank_link, bank_unlink, bank_links, bank_reconcile, bank_pay — adapters: sandbox (testnet, open), statement (camt.053/MT940/OFX/CSV in, ISO 20022 pain.001 out), openbanking (Berlin Group PSD2 / UK OBIE), mcp (a bank's own MCP server). Non-sandbox banks need the operator key (~/.mod/openhouse/bank_key, never served). Pool: openhouse_pool (quarter accruing now), pool_history (closed quarters), close_quarter (freeze + lock split), pool_claim (pull an address's share), bloctime (locked liquidity and earned weight for one address). Proofs (proof of rent paid, without the tenant): openhouse_proof_status, proof_program, proofs, proof, proof_issue (bank: runs the Cairo statement proof/ over the private payment, signs the fact for NEAR + Ethereum), proof_verify (anyone, offline), proof_open (tenant opens a commitment with their salt), proof_salt, proof_submit (relay to the NEAR WASM verifier openhouse.modnear-05ce1d.testnet or contracts/OpenHouseProofs.sol; chain=near|eth); openhouse_bank_reconcile issue_proofs=true issues one per booked transfer.
